text:
emma: Heads up — hosted API p95 jumped from ~110ms to ~420ms between 09:12-09:18 UTC. Noticing queue depth climbing on a subset of shards. Anyone else seeing this?

liam: saw the alert. which model/pool?

emma: pool=hosted-gpu-1, t2 instances. Affected tenants: a small percentage (~3%) but sustained. Quick metrics dump: 
```
09:10:00 p95=112ms p99=420ms qd_avg=2
09:14:00 p95=420ms p99=1.22s qd_avg=28
throughput_rps -12% (same ingress)
kvcache_evictions_per_min=380 -> 2.1k
batch_size_p50  = 6 -> 18
kernel_mismatch_ratio=5% -> 43%
```

raj: KV eviction spike looks important. eviction rate looks correlated with kernel_mismatch. Any recent prefetch sampler changes?

sofia: I rolled out the sampler tweak yesterday (prefetch sampler v1.8) to improve cold-starts. It increases aggressive prefetch for short sequences, might be flooding KV with short keys.

liam: we also had a minor scheduling tweak last night that nudges kernel selection heuristics to prefer smaller tiles for long sequences — could be interacting.

emma: ops-bot shows a deploy at 09:07 (prefetch sampler v1.8) and a config rollout at 08:50 for kernel-heuristics. Logs: 
```
[09:07:12] deploy: prefetch-sampler v1.8 -> canary
[09:07:45] canary promote -> pool hosted-gpu-1
[09:08:02] kernel-heuristics: affinity_override=enabled
```

raj: profiler snapshot from 09:15 (sampled on affected shard): 
```
CPU: 12% idle
GPU kernel selection: fallback_int8 (52%), fast_f32 (20%), generic_fp16 (28%)
KV cache lookups per request: 14 -> 46
KV cache miss latency p95: 3ms -> 28ms
context copy time increased 3x
```
Looks like prefetch overshot and thrashing KV, causing larger batches and kernel fallback to slower paths.

sofia: that matches my hypothesis — sampler increased prefetch concurrency which bloated in-flight KV keys and forced different batching shapes. If batching shape distribution shifts, runtime mispredicts kernel and falls back.

liam: immediate mitigation options?

emma: suggested quick actions:
- revert prefetch-sampler v1.8 (promote previous canary)
- temporarily disable affinity_override in kernel-heuristics
- add route rule to divert 10% traffic off hosted-gpu-1 to hosted-gpu-2

raj: I can rollback sampler canary now. Doing it.

ops-bot: action: rollback initiated by raj at 09:22:11 for prefetch-sampler v1.8 -> v1.7

sofia: also sending small patch to sampler to clamp prefetch concurrency per-tenant to 8 (hotfix).

liam: i'll disable affinity_override (kernel-heuristics) for hosted-gpu-1 now.

[09:29] raj: rollback completed, canary removed.

[09:31] sofia: hotfix deployed (clamp=8) to hosted pools.

[09:34] liam: affinity_override disabled on hosted-gpu-1.

emma: metrics update: 
```
09:36:00 p95=118ms p99=310ms qd_avg=3
09:40:00 p95=110ms p99=170ms qd_avg=2
kvcache_evictions_per_min down to ~420
kernel_mismatch_ratio -> 8%
```

sofia: looks like mitigation worked. We'll keep sampler clamp for now and run a regression test against long-tail workload.

liam: follow-ups:
- postmortem to track exact interaction between sampler prefetch concurrency + kernel heuristic thresholds
- add synthetic load test that simulates high short-sequence fanout to KV cache
- add an alert for kernel_mismatch_ratio > 20% as early warning

emma: thanks. tagging @oncall for visibility. I'll file an incident ticket with the timeline + logs. :thumbsup:

raj: noted. I'll keep an eye on the affected tenant list and re-run profiler against those shards tomorrow.

sofia: will add canary safety checks to sampler rollout (max prefetch concurrency per pool).

emma: closing thread for now — reopen if we see p95 > 200ms again.
